fields: as grid: h, intro, items [{t, d, tag, link, icon}]. Look-only fields: item "scene" (osd | proof | washer | suites | batch | lab) picks the drawing, else it follows the link page (ind-pharma, ind-process, ind-meddevice, ind-cdmo, ind-personal-care, ind-hospital-lab); block "spec_labels" (default Use, System, Checks) labels the spec lines in order, and an item's own "spec_labels" overrides it for that card.
best_for: ConfigCards sets typical configurations as design-basis cards: every card draws the same polypropylene (PP) package piped to the use it feeds, with the reference capacity, the design-basis tag and the configuration's spec lines under it.
